title: Same-at collapse silently drops the terminal event on legacy taken-over unreachable rows
evidence:
client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:1425-1435:
"fn collapse_same_at_sends(lines: List(TimelineLine)) -> List(TimelineLine) {
  lines
  |> list.fold([], fn(acc: List(TimelineLine), line: TimelineLine) {
    case acc {
      [] -> [line]
      [prev, ..rest] if prev.at == line.at -> acc
      _ -> [line, ..acc]
    }
  })
  |> list.reverse
}"

server/src/application/application_detail_handler.gleam:1457-1463:
"        first_non_empty([
          normalize_at(terminalized_at),
          normalize_at(submitted_at),
          normalize_at(objected_at),
          normalize_at(updated_at),
        ])"

server/src/reference_checks/sql/take_over_reference_call.sql:
"UPDATE reference_call
SET taken_over_at = now(),
    next_attempt_at = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1
  AND application_id = $2
  AND taken_over_at IS NULL
  AND status IN ('queued', 'contact_initiated', 'unreachable')"
detail: Pre-migration `unreachable` rows: the terminal entry falls back to `updated_at`; a takeover (allowed from unreachable) bumps `updated_at` to the takeover instant, so terminal and taken_over share one `at` and the collapse drops the terminal line — AC1's terminal event vanishes from timeline and export.
recommended_fix: Collapse only same-`at` send lines (compare kind, not just `at`), or never fall back to `updated_at` for the terminal instant when `taken_over_at` is set.

title: Client re-derives cadence progress with a cross-cycle batch count that diverges from the server's per-cycle restart
detail: Server restarts cadence position per correction cycle, but the client counts send batches across ALL cycles — post-correction rows hit 4+ batches mid-cycle and the next-reminder hint is wrongly suppressed. Client re-derives server-owned state; `next_attempt_at` is already on the payload.
recommended_fix: Derive the hint from `call.next_attempt_at` (already decoded on the wire) or a server-shipped cadence flag; drop the cross-cycle batch-count heuristic.

server/src/reference_checks/sweep.gleam:655:

detail: `failed` is a live v1 terminal (sweep error paths) and gets a terminal entry, but the two label tables miss it: the timeline says "Closed" while the export's Outcome says "In progress" — contradictory claims in the landlord's evidence record.
recommended_fix: Add `"failed"` arms to both tables (e.g. "The check couldn't complete" / "Couldn't complete"), and cover `"completed"`.

title: Queued-taken-over rows lose the export affordance that §7.7 attaches to the takeover surface
detail: Take-over is offered on queued rows and the SQL leaves status queued; the taken-over surface (chips + label) renders, but the export button now lives only in the attempt-log block, which is suppressed for Queued — §7.7's export-beside-the-chips contract breaks.
recommended_fix: Render the export affordance for taken-over rows regardless of status (e.g. let the log block render when `taken_over_at` is set), preserving RC4.3's takeover-surface export.

title: New RC4.4 copy consts bypass the em-dash pin list
detail: The RC4.3 convention pins every new refcheck const in the em-dash scan list; the nine RC4.4 consts (block title, timeline labels, export labels) are not added, so the CI ban silently stops covering the new surface.
recommended_fix: Add the new dash-free consts to `refcheck_action_strings`, keeping the toast-exported exclusion comment.
